title: Rich Dad Poor Dad Lied To You
summary: Investor argues the rich-dad cash flow quadrant is just tax labels; proposes a four-level 'investor matrix' from spender-saver to master allocator using other people's money.

assertions.quote: it is a total fallacy that you can't be a worker and be a billionaire or massively financially free
you can sometimes get talked into get rich quick schemes like day trading crypto strategies throwing money into crowdfunding

verdicts.note: Financial literacy correlates with avoiding fraud in surveys; the matrix itself is unvalidated.

assertions.quote: we need to think about how to progress in a financial literacy which sounds boring except it makes you a lot of money

verdicts.note: A framework rather than a measurable claim.

assertions.quote: you don't have to use just your own money you get other people's on top of it
he doesn't realize that it's not keeping up with inflation
due to your expertise you get unfair access into deals opportunities research insights this means that you get returns that most people don't

verdicts.note: Private-deal access does exist, but it is a tiny group and returns are not reliably superior.
